name: Tsukugami Kitsune
source:
Part of discipline committee like a few others can do super human feats. Has great admiration for Neko that might even have a masochist side getting jealous of people that get scold by Neko. Is also a little self conscious of her height being close to 180 cm being seen as not lady like.

Hobbies: Picking on newbies/underclassmen
